x-ectwin.runs_in: Commons job impact-db-backfill (one-off 2010-2026 backfill, then daily for new records)
x-ectwin.data_class_rule: Historical records with free text are pseudonymised with Cloud DLP; ECU 911 narratives are C3 and follow the incident_record routing rule.

placeholders.record_text: Pseudonymised description or comment text of the record, max 1,500 characters
placeholders.event_label_verbatim: Event type as recorded by the source, verbatim
placeholders.cause_verbatim: Cause as recorded by the source, verbatim, or empty string
placeholders.place_label: Resolved place label (from B3), or raw place text

code_decides_without_jev: Dates, counts (people, homes, hectares), DPA codes (via B3), ENSO phase at event time (join to enso_indices by date), duplicates by exact source id.
notes: Multi-label questions are one Noul per label (Jev returns no lists).
Pairs of records that may describe the same event are resolved with event_dedupe (S6).
x-ectwin.output: Label columns on commons_internal.impact_events (docs/05-data-catalog.md section 4.9), promoted to commons_pub after review

is_hydromet.instructions: Does `record` describe an event caused by rain, rivers, the sea, landslides or wind (not traffic, crime, fire unrelated to weather or medical emergencies)?

criteria.socavamiento: Undermining or erosion of roads, banks or foundations

rain_or_sea_triggered.instructions: According to `record`, was the event triggered by rainfall, rising rivers or sea conditions?

coastal_compound.instructions: Does `record` describe rain or river flooding made worse by high tide, swell or sea level?

homes_damaged.instructions: Does `record` report homes affected, damaged or destroyed?

road_or_bridge.instructions: Does `record` report a road or bridge affected, blocked or destroyed?

school_or_health.instructions: Does `record` report a school or health facility affected?

water_or_power.instructions: Does `record` report drinking water, sewer, electricity or telecommunications affected?

crops_livestock_or_aquaculture.instructions: Does `record` report crops, livestock, shrimp ponds or fisheries affected?

people_displaced.instructions: Does `record` report people or families displaced, evacuated or in shelters?

deaths_or_injuries.instructions: Does `record` report people dead, missing or injured?

severity.instructions: How severe is the impact described in `record`?
criteria: Moderate: access cut or property damaged
Serious: homes destroyed, critical services hit or families displaced
Severe: deaths, missing people or large-scale displacement
